_comment: Per-project metadata + verified issues from the deep audit. type: 'app'=interactive tool, 'website'=brand/marketing site. issues[].sev: red|amber. Edit freely.

pilates-finder.label: Reformed
pilates-finder.purpose: Reformer pilates studio finder (Google Places + Claude ranking)

issues.title: Google Places key committed & shipped to every browser
issues.action: Restrict the Places/Maps key to *.curiousbrand.co.uk in Google Cloud Console; consider proxying via a function

issues.title: All tracking IDs are stubs — GA4/Meta/GAds don't fire
issues.action: Set real GA4/GTM/pixel IDs or remove the stubs; wire the Google Ads remarketing tag

BriefQuiz.label: Brief Quiz (v1)
BriefQuiz.purpose: Earlier brief diagnostic — leads stay in localStorage

issues.title: Leads saved to localStorage only — never captured
issues.action: Wire the capture to Brevo/Supabase or retire this v1 in favour of Brief Quiz v2

issues.title: Admin dashboard gated only by client-side password 'admin123' in the URL
issues.action: Move admin auth server-side (Supabase Auth/RLS); remove the hardcoded password from the bundle immediately

issues.title: Two Supabase project refs across the codebase
issues.action: Consolidate to one project; remove the stale ref

issues.title: Exposed Resend key — code now reads from env, but the old key is still LIVE
issues.action: ROTATE the key in Resend now (it's dead only after that), then: supabase secrets set RESEND_API_KEY=<new-key>. Code already fixed on main + posd.

issues.title: Permissive RLS — anon can read/overwrite/delete all saved data
issues.action: Require 'authenticated' and scope writes by created_by = auth.uid()

issues.title: .env holds many live production secrets in a synced Desktop folder
issues.action: Ensure it never enters git (it's ignored) and isn't in a shared/cloud-synced path; rotate if ever exposed
